studies.Journal: Journal of clinical oncology : official journal of the American Society of Clinical Oncology
studies.Design: Nested case-control study within a prospective cohort
studies.Timing: Baseline blood collection with observation from 1990 to 2005; mean follow-up 12.8 years
studies.comparison_type: Highest versus lowest plasma genistein group for localized prostate cancer

sample_size.excerpt: A total of 14,203 men aged 40 to 69 years who had returned the baseline questionnaire and provided blood samples were observed from 1990 to 2005. During a mean of 12.8 years of follow-up, 201 newly diagnosed prostate cancers were identified.
sample_size.location: Abstract, methods

cases.excerpt: During a mean of 12.8 years of follow-up, 201 newly diagnosed prostate cancers were identified.
